integrity: Self-contained analytic theorem with reproducible numerical and symbolic checks; publication priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two independent noiseless node draws for Brownian-bridge kernel and uniform target integration; expected fixed-node worst-case squared error/posterior integral variance, not the supremum of expected squared error. A specialized unlocated exact two-knot cubic-spacing result could affect priority; deterministic/correlated designs are outside the optimum.
title: Unique optimal i.i.d. two-node design for Brownian-bridge kernel quadrature
